title: Pañcagati
text: 2. Atha kho Bhagavā parittam nakhasikhāyam paṃsum āropetvā bhikkhū āmantesi || || 3. Taṃ kim maññatha bhikkhave || katamaṃ nu kho bahutaraṃ yo vāyam mayā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito || ayaṃ vā mahāpathavī ti || || Etad eva bhante bahutaraṃ yad idam mahāpathavī appamattako yam Bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito saṅkham pi na upeti upanidham pi na upeti kalabhāgam pi na upeti mahāpathavim upanidhāya Bhagavatā paritto nakhasikhāyam paṃsu āropito ti || || 4. Evam eva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye manussā cutā manussesu paccājāyanti || atha kho ete va bahutarā sattā ye manussā cutā niraye paccājāyanti || la-pe || ||
